channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Africa's tobacco policy failure: Illicit trade grows, harm reduction stalls
item.description: Africa's tobacco control challenges extend beyond smoking prevalence, with illicit tobacco trade expanding and access to safer nicotine alternatives remaining limited in many countries. (Published on November 12, 2026byenvironewsnigeria.com)

item.title: EU Commission declines to confirm December timetable for nicotine rules
item.description: The European Commission has declined to confirm whether its proposed revision of the Tobacco Products Directive will be published in December, amid reports of a possible delay until January 2027. (Published on November 13, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: Quitting smoking: vaping helps without support, but twice as well with it
item.description: A UK randomised controlled trial involving 1,170 smokers found that providing e-cigarettes without behavioural support helped more participants quit smoking than automated cessation advice alone. (Published on November 13, 2026byvapingpost.com)
